The tiled corner and partly cropped cistern align. The rear of the fitting remains out of view.
The same close brick face fills each view. Darkness limits inspection of the service mechanism.
Floor boards, table and companion retain the same framing. The tabletop reflection shifts slightly.
The round lamp beam and curtain light the same tile field. The seat still falls partly outside the frame.
The resident, doorway, soft furnishings and main floor boards retain their positions. The doorway remains bright.
The chair, reading shelves and moonlit window match. The open floor and companion stay legible.
The sink, cabinetry and light remain aligned. The prior frame contains a transient subtitle.
The panel housing, exposed fittings and conduit remain in the same positions. Light on the opening door and knobs varies.
The Judge remains below the counter with the visible tiled floor and both foreground supports. His cushion is still dark.
The shelf, photograph and curled Lafitte remain visible at the same position. The frame remains deliberately dim.
The canopy, supports and wall pictures retain their silhouettes. The canopy still masks much of the venue.
The mail slots, frame and bench stay aligned. The wall remains in low light.
The radiator, window shade and desk retain the same positions. The foreground radiator remains tightly cropped.
The railing, stairs, doorway and roof sign align and retain legibility.
The tank, ladder and city silhouette align. Clouds differ slightly between the two captures.
The lit controls and board are both visible. The adjacent wood panel and shadows occupy different parts of the comparison.
The cistern and tiled walls remain correctly framed. A shadow crosses the right edge of the newer cistern view.
The floor residue remains legible in the lamp pool on the same boards. The companion screen and tilt vary.
The foreground shape retains its floor contact and silhouette. The lamp and companion show small transient shifts.
The counter and all major toaster, kettle and bread forms align. Small crumb and speck positions vary.
The same wall-fitting outline and lit dial remain readable against the dark wall.
